sound_design: Italian Riviera Chillout Lounge. Calm, romantic Italian dinner music with an elegant 1960s dolce vita jet-set feeling. Soft bossa nova groove with brushed drums and light shaker, warm nylon-string guitar and gentle mandolin melodies, mellow Rhodes and grand piano, round upright bass, lush string pads like a classic Italian film score, a subtle touch of accordion. Distant sea waves and evening cicadas in the background. Sunset aperitivo on the Amalfi Coast, candlelit terrace dinner on Lake Como, Mediterranean warmth, relaxed, sophisticated, nostalgic and romantic. Intimate high-end lounge production, warm analog tape character, clean mix, no vocals, 88 BPM. Focus: Riviera café jazz – light swing, muted trumpet, vibraphone, espresso bar on the piazza. Warm, analog-style Italian Riviera chillout lounge centered around a mellow 88 BPM bossa nova and light swing feel. Instrumentation relies on brushed jazz drums, round upright bass, warm nylon-string guitar, soft mandolin picking, and a lush cinematic string section. The acoustic space feels organic and intimate, framed by subtle background textures like distant sea waves and evening cicadas.

_brief.visual_rule: For THIS line the general rule 'people only small or seen from behind' does NOT apply. Every art_prompt and thumbnail_prompt shows ONE attractive, elegant woman with a feminine silhouette in a fitted evening gown that matches the scene (use the motif's gown), clearly visible from knee or waist up, face visible and beautiful, standing at the FAR RIGHT of the frame (face in the right quarter, x above 75%), framed medium-wide so her head is SMALL (head height about 8% of the image height) with the WHOLE head, forehead to chin, between 30% and 40% from the top – fully visible, never cut off at the top (the square image is also cropped to 16:9 from the middle, losing the top 22%) and never below 42% (the big title lines run across the image from 32% down), because the big title is set across the middle and must cover only her dress, never her face. Always sunset light and dinner mood (candles, wine or aperitivo glasses, white linen). The famous place (Amalfi Coast / Lake Como as named in the motif) fills the left side and the background, with sunset sky over sea or lake. Write it as a real professional editorial photo shoot (camera, lens, natural light, skin texture, film grain) – never 'illustration', 'render' or 'digital art'. Classy and advertiser-friendly: no lingerie, no cleavage focus, no suggestive pose.
